chunks: Yunus, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the fornicator: when he commits zina, is he to be banished? He said: “Yes, from the place in which he was flogged to another place.”

key_terms.الزَّانِي: the fornicator; the person who commits zina
key_terms.جُلِدَ: was flogged; received the prescribed lash punishment
key_terms.زَنَى: committed zina; engaged in illicit sexual intercourse
key_terms.غَيْرِهَا: another place; somewhere other than that location
key_terms.يُنْفَى: is banished; is exiled from a place

ai.seo_question: Is a fornicator banished after being flogged in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the punishment of the fornicator, stating that banishment applies after the prescribed flogging. It indicates that the offender is to be removed from the locality in which the hadd punishment was carried out to another place.
